name: MiniAppHub (.NET 10)
postCreateCommand: dotnet dev-certs https --trust && npm install -g azurite && dotnet --info && func --version
postStartCommand: dotnet dev-certs https --check --trust >/dev/null 2>&1 || dotnet dev-certs https --trust; mkdir -p /tmp/azurite && (bash -c 'echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/10000' >/dev/null 2>&1 || setsid azurite --silent --location /tmp/azurite --debug /tmp/azurite/debug.log </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &)
